captions.detailed: A pair of 8x42 roof-prism hunting binoculars with a matte black finish. It consists of two main optical barrels connected by a central hinge assembly, with a large, textured rubber-coated center focus knob positioned at the top rear of the central pivot. The front objective lenses feature deep green anti-reflective coatings, while the rear eyepieces are capped with dark circular rings. The central hinge allows the barrels to fold inward or outward to adjust for interpupillary distance, and the focus knob rotates continuously about the central axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an 8x42 roof-prism hunting binocular. It should feature two main black optical barrels, a central pivot hinge allowing rotational articulation, and a prominent center focus knob that rotates on a continuous revolute joint. The objective lenses must have a distinct dark teal-green glass material.
captions.factory: The code constructs a central bridge assembly as the base part. It then adds a left barrel and a right barrel as separate parts, connected to the bridge via revolute joints along the central longitudinal axis to simulate the folding interpupillary adjustment. A large cylinder with a knurled or grooved pattern is added at the rear of the bridge as a focus knob, connected via a continuous revolute joint. The objective and eyepiece lenses are modeled as flat cylinders embedded into the barrel ends and assigned a teal-green glass material, while the body parts are assigned a matte black material.
